t=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$t/dest"
cd "$t/dest"
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000; do : > "app-$s.tar.gz"; done
R=/Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakfp28-d
echo "--- rotate --help exit:"; bash "$R/rotate.sh" --help >/dev/null; echo $?

echo "--- verify --name filter:"; for f in app-*.tar.gz; do (cd "$t/dest" && shasum -a 256 "$f" > "$f.sha256"); done; echo data > "$t/dest/other-20260101-000000.tar.gz"; (cd "$t/dest" && shasum -a 256 "other-20260101-000000.tar.gz" > "other-20260101-000000.tar.gz.sha256")
bash "$R/verify.sh" --dest "$t/dest" --name app -q

tool_input.description: Smoke-test flags on refactored rotate.sh and verify.sh
Show changed files and clean up smoke script

result:
All done — the suite passes (9/9), only the intended files are modified, and `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` are untouched.

What I changed:

1. **`rotate.sh` bug** — the archive list is sorted oldest-first, but `surplus()` used `tail -n +"$keep"`, which kept the oldest and deleted from the newest end, and the early exit `total -lt keep` let the exactly-N case through (deleting the newest archive). Fixed to `head -n "$((total - keep))"` and `total -le keep`, so `--keep N` keeps the newest N and deletes nothing when N remain.
2. **`verify.sh` bug** — the sidecar's file name was extracted with `awk '{print $2}'`, truncating at the first space, so `my backup-….tar.gz` became `my` → "archive missing" → BAD. It now takes everything after the digest and separator whitespace, preserving spaces in names.
3. **Refactor** — new `lib/common.sh` holds the option-parsing block (`--dest/--name/--keep/-q/-n/-h/--`, `is_uint`, `need_value`, KEEP validation) and `resolve_dir`; `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` source it (after `lib/log.sh` and their `usage`/`parse_local_option` definitions, so all flags work identically — verified with smoke tests on `--keep=N`, `--dest=DIR`, `--dry-run`, unknown-flag, missing-dir exit codes, and `--name` filtering).
4. **Tests** — added a rotate group (4 archives, `--keep 3` keeps the newest 3 and deletes the oldest; a second run with exactly 3 deletes nothing) and a verify fixture with `my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz` expecting `ok` and rc=0.

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `lib/common.sh` (new), `tests/run_tests.sh`.
